entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Our master would like a word with you.[n]Stand up straight and listen closely,[n]Inmate.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: It seems you freed the heart of a frenzied[n]girl and saved her from her haunted past.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: *chuckle* Another step has been taken to[n]rehabilitation... You are progressing quite[n]nicely.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Our master bestows words of praise[n]upon you! You'd better feel honored!

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: By the by, more curious information has[n]found its way to your ears.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: A scientist's research... It seems that world[n]may secretly be known after all.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Furthermore, that very research has been[n]stolen and is now used by those with[n]malicious intent...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: I wonder how this will change the[n]approach you take toward your[n]rehabilitation...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Allow me to grant you a new power[n]worthy of your current self.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: I believe I told you we would spare no[n]expense in cooperating with you.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Allow me to grant you a new power[n]worthy of your current self.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Though you have my aid, be sure not to[n]let your guard down. Otherwise you may[n]get swept off your feet...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: ...We shall meet again in the near future.
I feel like my bond with Igor[n]is growing deeper...
